research_question: Owned-page scope: Responding to Law Firm Online Reviews. Planned sources and method: State bar guidance and platform policies; legal review before publication. Build a source-labelled comparison covering responding to attorney reviews and legal review response policy; record dates, definitions and sample limits. Sources are proposed, not verified findings.

research_brief.purpose: Owner-supplied editorial draft for law firm online reviews, fact-checked and fitted to house rules.
research_brief.audience: Managing partners, marketing leads, and intake managers at U.S. law firms.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Editorial framework; worked numbers are labeled hypothetical. ABA Model Rule web pages could not be opened, so those citations were reworded without links.

plan.reader_title: Law Firm Online Reviews: Protect Confidentiality Before Publishing a Reply
plan.seo_title: Law Firm Online Reviews: Set a Safe Response Policy
plan.meta_description: Handle law firm online reviews with a documented response process that preserves confidentiality, separates removal requests, and assigns attorney approval.
outline: Recognize the Difference Between Reputation and Confidentiality
Preserve the Record Without Broadening Access
Classify the Situation Before Choosing an Action
Consider No Public Reply as a Deliberate Option
Draft Only What the Firm Can Approve
Keep Private Resolution Separate From Public Editing
Give Vendors a Clear Publishing Boundary
Handle Positive Reviews With Similar Care
Create a Response Register With Minimal Information
Train the Team Before the Next Difficult Review
Review Indirect Disclosures in the Entire Reply
Correct an Unapproved Reply Through the Escalation Process

claims.statement: ABA Formal Opinion 496, issued January 13, 2021, says a negative online review alone does not justify disclosure under the self-defense exception.
Google content policy covers fake engagement and other prohibited content.
FTC guidance addresses unfounded or groundless threats used to suppress reviews.
